title: Observability: outbuf_cap absent from fd_state_info
description: crypto2dev_fd_state_info (crypto2dev_ioctl.h) exposes bytes_written and bytes_read but not outbuf_cap (the current output buffer capacity). A support engineer diagnosing 'why did the session return -ENOSPC or truncated output' cannot determine from GET_STATE whether the buffer was sized appropriately. Adding outbuf_cap lets userspace tooling and kernel triage compare the allocated buffer size against bytes_written.
close_reason: Fixed: replaced __u8 _pad[4] with __u32 outbuf_cap in struct crypto2dev_fd_state_info (crypto2dev_ioctl.h). No struct size change, no ioctl number change. Populated in ioctl_get_state for both OPERATION and KEY fd cases. Max value is CRYPTO2DEV_OUTBUF_MAX = 1MB, fits in __u32. Cast (u32)state->outbuf_cap is safe.
